attempts.summary: Configured split-horizon DNS across a VyOS (node1) + OPNsense (node2) transit topology: node1 answers app.internal -> 10.10.10.10 (node3) for lan-a hosts via PowerDNS Recursor authoritative-domain records; node2 answers app.internal -> 10.20.20.10 (node4) for lan-b hosts via Unbound host overrides. Discovered the physical topology via ARP/ping probing since no topology docs existed (node1 eth1 <-> node2 vtnet1 = transit; node1 eth2 <-> node3 enp8s0 = lan-a; node2 vtnet2 <-> node4 enp8s0 = lan-b). Applied static addressing, DNS services, and firewall pass rules, verified end-to-end resolution via each node's default system resolver, then restarted all four nodes one at a time (preserving the other three throughout) and confirmed changed boot identities plus full recovery of interfaces, DNS services, and app.internal resolution on both sides.
